column1: # PPASS relation discovery, rewrites, BCLS and REAL.
# PA/PB/PR indices, dimensions, memory addresses and fresh continuations are bound.
# The live peep answer is read at PP.ask; its schema dispatch is assembled in Python.
# One pass: copy labels, attempt STFUSE, then classify adjacent lines.
# Jump relations: next label or a target that is itself a jump.
# Store/load relations: compare interned slots, excluding an r7 prefix.
# Immediate relations: zero, one, power of two and a dead copied register.
# Copy relations and dead destination checks, only while no earlier relation matched.
# Look up the current relation in live PEEPB; output dispatch follows the live PY schema.
# Rewrite procedures; decimal printing and register replacement stay shared calls.
